definitions.full: H5945. elyown I. עֶלְיוֺן 22 adjective 1 high ; — masculine singular ׳ע Deut 26:19 ; 28:1 ; 1Kin 9:8 (? reading הָע הַזֶּה ׳הַבַּיִת as ᵐ5 L Benz) = 2Chr 7:21 , of ׳י Psa 97:9 . 2 upper Bethhoron, ׳ע Josh 16:5 העליון 1Chr 7:24 ; 2Chr 8:5 , the upper (opposed to lower), of house Neh 3:25 ; compare 2Kin 15:35 ; 2Chr 23:20 5 t., + Gen 40:17 ( uppermost basket); feminine singular הָעֶלְיוֺנָה the upper pool 2Kin 18:17 = Isa 36:2 ; 7:3 ; the highest side-chamber ( צֵלָע ) Ezek 41:7 ; feminine plural הָעֶלְיוֺנֹת 42:5 the upper chambers ( לְשָׁכוֺת ). 3 of Davidic king exalted above monarchs Psa 89:28 (compare Deut 28:1 , above). II. עֶלְיוֺן noun masculine Highest, Most High (probably = foregoing); — 1 name of God Num 24:16 ; Deut 32:8 ; Psa 18:14 = 2Sam 22:14 ; Psa 9:3 ; 21:8 ; 46:5 ; 50:14 ; 73:11 ; 77:11 ; 78:17 ; Psalm 83:19; 87:5 ; 91:1 ; 91:9 ; 92:2 ; 107:11 ; Isa 14:14 ; Lam 3:35 , 38 ; with other divine names: עליון אל Gen 14:18-19 , 20 , 22 (see Di) Psa 78:35 ; עליון יהוה Psalm 7:18; 47:3 ; עליון אלהים 57:3 ; 78:56 . 5 of rulers, either monarchs or angel-princes , עֶלְיוֺן בְּנֵי = אלהים Psa 82:6 .
